title: L4 LLM Interpretation Output
description: Structured output payload emitted by the L4 LLM interpretation layer (chunk #83+). Schema version 2.0 / prompt version v2.1. JSON-constrained via mistralrs strict-schema mode (llguidance integration).

schema_version.description: Embedded provenance per dist-arch v3 section L4; fixed at the chunk #83 substrate.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template version. Primary tier follows the v2.x lineage; fallback tier the v1.x-fallback lineage; reflection tier the v1.x-reflection lineage.

decision.description: Surface decision: surface (create incident), dismiss (no action), watch (record but do not surface).

severity.description: Severity classification per P-019 Three-Tier Severity Model.

hypotheses.description: Ranked hypothesis list per P-033 (primary tier emits up to 5; fallback tier emits 1).

investigation_steps.description: Suggested investigation actions per P-034 (primary tier emits up to 5; fallback tier emits up to 2).

evidence_refs.description: Identifiers pointing back to source telemetry, copied VERBATIM from the prompt's Citable Evidence Ids section (full-hex fingerprint strings); empty when that section lists none. Never invented.

fingerprint.description: Content-stable identity used for cross-incident deduplication.

model_tier.description: Bounded snake_case label identifying which tier produced this output.

hardware_profile.description: Bounded snake_case label identifying the runtime hardware profile at inference time.

is_resolution_summary.description: True when this output documents an incident transition to Resolved; false for active inference.
